positive_source: HIPPIE v3.0; snapshot matches author release pairs and scores

homology.accession_family_policy: exclude every UniProt entry/isoform family connected to a test accession; keep same family within one development split

positive_scope.duplicate_policy: unordered exact sequence pair; retain evidence mapping

annotations.isoform_go_policy: parent UniProt entry terms; explicitly recorded, not isoform-specific evidence
annotations.unresolved_sequence_policy: exclude and report; never replace missing isoform sequence with an arbitrary canonical sequence

positive_split.must_link: all detected >=40% identity, >=80% both-coverage edges plus UniProt entry families
positive_split.grouping_graph: MMseqs2 normalized bit scores; group count reduced if largest must-link component prevents 100 balanced groups

negative_sampling.method: author ILP with explicit known-positive blacklist and no-self adaptation
negative_sampling.known_positive_blacklist: conservative UniProt-family projection of all HIPPIE positives plus historical train/validation/test positives
negative_sampling.candidate_excess_selection: seeded random within GO priority strata, correcting upstream sorted-key truncation
